scene.label: Act 2, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Britain. Imogen's bedchamber in Cymbeline's palace; a trunk in one corner.
scene.location: Britain. Imogen's bedchamber in Cymbeline's palace; a trunk in one corner.

content.text: Enter Imogen in her bed, and a Lady attending.

lines.text: Who's there? My woman Helen?
lines.plainText: Who's there My woman Helen

lines.text: Please you, madam.
lines.plainText: Please you madam

lines.text: What hour is it?
lines.plainText: What hour is it

lines.text: Almost midnight, madam.
lines.plainText: Almost midnight madam

lines.text: I have read three hours then. Mine eyes are weak;
lines.plainText: I have read three hours then Mine eyes are weak

lines.text: Fold down the leaf where I have left. To bed.
lines.plainText: Fold down the leaf where I have left To bed

lines.text: Take not away the taper, leave it burning;
lines.plainText: Take not away the taper leave it burning

lines.text: And if thou canst awake by four o' th' clock,
lines.plainText: And if thou canst awake by four o' th' clock

lines.text: I prithee call me. Sleep hath seiz'd me wholly.
lines.plainText: I prithee call me Sleep hath seiz'd me wholly

lines.text: The crickets sing, and man's o'er-labour'd sense
lines.plainText: The crickets sing and man's o'erlabour'd sense

lines.text: Repairs itself by rest. Our Tarquin thus
lines.plainText: Repairs itself by rest Our Tarquin thus

lines.text: Did softly press the rushes ere he waken'd
lines.plainText: Did softly press the rushes ere he waken'd

lines.text: The chastity he wounded. Cytherea,
lines.plainText: The chastity he wounded Cytherea

lines.text: How bravely thou becom'st thy bed! fresh lily,
lines.plainText: How bravely thou becom'st thy bed fresh lily

lines.text: And whiter than the sheets! That I might touch!
lines.plainText: And whiter than the sheets That I might touch

lines.text: But kiss; one kiss! Rubies unparagon'd,
lines.plainText: But kiss one kiss Rubies unparagon'd

lines.text: How dearly they do't! 'Tis her breathing that
lines.plainText: How dearly they do't 'Tis her breathing that

lines.text: Perfumes the chamber thus. The flame o' th' taper
lines.plainText: Perfumes the chamber thus The flame o' th' taper

lines.text: Bows toward her and would under-peep her lids
lines.plainText: Bows toward her and would underpeep her lids

lines.text: To see th' enclosed lights, now canopied
lines.plainText: To see th' enclosed lights now canopied

lines.text: Under these windows white and azure, lac'd
lines.plainText: Under these windows white and azure lac'd

lines.text: With blue of heaven's own tinct. But my design
lines.plainText: With blue of heaven's own tinct But my design

lines.text: To note the chamber. I will write all down:
lines.plainText: To note the chamber I will write all down

lines.text: Such and such pictures; there the window; such
lines.plainText: Such and such pictures there the window such

lines.text: Th' adornment of her bed; the arras, figures,
lines.plainText: Th' adornment of her bed the arras figures

lines.text: Why, such and such; and the contents o' th' story.
lines.plainText: Why such and such and the contents o' th' story

lines.text: Ah, but some natural notes about her body
lines.plainText: Ah but some natural notes about her body

lines.text: Above ten thousand meaner movables
lines.plainText: Above ten thousand meaner movables

lines.text: Would testify, t' enrich mine inventory.
lines.plainText: Would testify t' enrich mine inventory

lines.text: O sleep, thou ape of death, lie dull upon her!
lines.plainText: O sleep thou ape of death lie dull upon her

lines.text: And be her sense but as a monument,
lines.plainText: And be her sense but as a monument

lines.text: Thus in a chapel lying! Come off, come off;
lines.plainText: Thus in a chapel lying Come off come off
